description: Start or poll a connect request so you can act on a site as the user without ever seeing their cookies or password. Pass site (and optionally scopes and reason) to start: the result has a link and user_prompt to show the user, and a connect_id. Pass connect_id to poll: status connected returns an opaque session handle for alterlab_task_start. Use before alterlab_task_start; for a page that needs no login use alterlab_scrape.

connect_id.description: Id from a started connect. Poll only

reason.description: Why you need access, shown to the user. Start only

scopes.description: Access to ask for. Start only

site.description: Site to connect, for example reddit.com. Start only

name: alterlab_connect
title: Connect a Site
